decision: The current frontend correctly rejects the response from the running backend because the response omits its screening-job ID and exposes an older maneuver response schema. The checked-out backend implementation passes the same archived event/job case, but the running backend was not restarted per instruction. Live TLE events still lack covariance and HBR. A separate explicitly synthetic research-scenario Pc path is available and passed API-level checks; no browser interaction was possible.

maneuver_investigation.root_cause: The frontend is connected to http://127.0.0.1:8001, as confirmed in the Vite-transformed src/api/ssaClient.js. It requests POST /api/conjunctions/{event_id}/maneuver?screening_job_id={selected_job_id} with the selected event JSON. The running API response has no top-level screening_job_id. The frontend therefore rejects it at its identity guard. This is a runtime API contract/version mismatch, not evidence of a conflicting event ID or a reason to bypass provenance validation.

pc_investigation.archived_physical_events: Inspected five local screening-job archives. Their physical event records have no covariance matrices or HBR values and no available collision probability. The examined event CA-0E45D17A7FD97444E98C reports collision_probability.status=unavailable, pc=null, reason codes NO_COVARIANCE and HBR_UNAVAILABLE; physics covariance and hard_body_radius fields are unavailable/null.
pc_investigation.local_historical_dataset: backend/ml_data/train_data.zip contains only train_data.csv (103 columns). It includes historical covariance-derived fields and per-object sigma/covariance terms, but no HBR column. The bundled CSV does not contain the object designators and absolute event TCA needed to bind a row to a current screening event, and the ZIP has no accompanying raw CDM or schema document establishing supported live-event frame/epoch/unit provenance. It was not used as a Pc input.
pc_investigation.supported_ingestion: The checked-out API supports event-bound CCSDS CDM import and an explicitly assumed separate research-scenario Pc route. CDM import validates the two segments, object identifiers, TCA, frame, covariance matrix/units and HBR. The Foster 2D implementation requires compatible covariance inputs and an explicit independence assumption when cross-correlation is absent.

This is component/API-level evidence, not browser verification.

pc_investigation.live_pc_limitation: Live TLE-derived events have no event-bound covariance for either object and no sourced combined HBR. Without compatible same-TCA covariance matrices, HBR provenance, and justified/explicit correlation assumptions, Foster Pc remains unavailable. The ESA historical log-risk output is not a substitute.

It preserves computation_status separately and sets result/completion/coverage status to partial.

screening_response_limit.assessment: For a reported 165 generated close approaches and 120 returned records, 45 records are omitted by the configured response cap; this is not a claim that the displayed 120 contain all generated assessments. No metadata or cap defect was reproduced, so the cap and partial status were left unchanged.

scientific_limitations.collision_ai: The ESA model predicts historical ESA log-risk. Phase 14.1 evaluation found zero of 145 held-out high-risk labels detected at the evaluated threshold. It is not a validated alert model or Foster Pc estimator.
scientific_limitations.maneuver_ai: The model is trained on synthetic simulator-labelled scenarios. Phase 15 reported 3/12 held-out exact best-candidate matches and worse mean miss-distance regret than the minimum-delta-v baseline. It is experimental ranking support, not maneuver effectiveness or operational safety.
scientific_limitations.maneuver_physics: The candidate engine is a warning-qualified two-body research simulation; it does not calculate post-maneuver Pc or establish operational feasibility.
scientific_limitations.archive: The archived maneuver demonstration job is partial and contains historical TLE-derived data retrieved 2026-10-14. Do not present it as current orbital conditions.
